rebuttals.text: Pete Buttigieg is a McKinsey android who speaks entirely in focus-grouped word salad.
Mayor Pete couldn't even fix the potholes in South Bend.
Pete Buttigieg has spent his whole career auditioning for the next job instead of doing the one he has.
Pete Buttigieg has no convictions and will say whatever the room wants to hear.

rebuttals.text: Pete Buttigieg has no natural base in either wing of the Democratic Party.

because.text: Pete Buttigieg treats progressive movements as constituencies to be managed rather than causes to be joined.
